messages:
Marta (DevEx): quick design check — I'm iterating on the invoke helper / handoff copy and a tiny layout tweak for the function defs panel. attaching a 2-frame gif. TL;DR: make the call button clearer when a function has required params, and change the 'Copy' affordance so screenreaders announce 'copy function signature'.
Tara (Design): seeing the gif — nice. my main concern: when required params collapse we lose context. can we keep a subtle chip that says '2 required' next to fn name?
Kai (Eng): chip is fine, but if we add chips per fn we'll need to update memoization keys in the playground store. small perf hit for large workspaces.
Ravi (PM): chip + tooltip sounds good to me. also want to ensure copy is consistent with the CLI examples on the docs page.
Sam (A11y): flagged two things: 1) the copy button currently uses aria-label=\"Copy\" which is ambiguous. prefer aria-label=\"Copy function signature for <function name>\". 2) when a param is auto-filled from a previous call, do we announce that? screen reader users should know 'auto-filled from last invocation'.
Marta (DevEx): thanks Sam — good catch. for the copy label i mocked: aria-label=\"Copy function signature: calculateOrder(customerId, items)\". what do folks think of including the signature in the label vs just the fn name?
Tara (Design): including full signature helps discoverability but may be verbose for long schemas. maybe show full signature in tooltip only, keep aria-label concise: \"Copy signature for calculateOrder\". tooltip can show full text and wrap.
Kai (Eng): agree with Tara. aria-label shorter, tooltip has full. also for the '2 required' chip, instead of reactive recalculation on every keystroke, we can debounce at 300ms and compute diffs server-side for huge schemas.
Ravi (PM): are there any analytics we'd want from this? e.g., clicks on copy, toggles on params? could feed Optimize suggestions later.
Marta (DevEx): yes please. track: copy_click, autofill_accept, param_toggle, and handoff_complete. low-cardinality props: workspace_id, fn_name, required_count.
Sam (A11y): one more a11y nit: when handoff completes (user sends a tool call to the runtime), we currently show a toast only. for screen reader announce live region: \"Function call sent: calculateOrder — 2 required parameters provided\".
Tara (Design): visual suggestion: when a function has pending errors from schema validation, outline the fn card in red + show inline help icon with small explainer. avoids modal.
Kai (Eng): inline help is cheap. validation summary can be computed during schema save. also we should avoid too many simultaneous tooltips on hover — mobile/touch needs a persistent help icon.
Marta (DevEx): actionable items: 1) Tara to provide 2 mocks: (a) chip + tooltip for required, (b) inline help variant. 2) Kai to prototype debounce + telemetry hooks. 3) Sam to write aria-label phrasing guidelines for copy/autofill/notifications. 4) I'll add tracking events to the product doc.
Tara (Design): will drop mocks by EOD tomorrow. calling out that the chip should be 12px height, 10px horizontal padding, and use token color --interactive-10.
Kai (Eng): noted. i'll spike the debounce pattern and post a small patch with the telemetry contract by Thursday.
Ravi (PM): thanks team. small ask: add a short line in release notes about 'improved function call accessibility and copy affordances' so support knows what to expect.
ux-bot: reminder — design review meeting scheduled Fri 11am to finalize.
Marta (DevEx): perfect. if anyone has microcopy alternatives, post here. my quick stab for the copy tooltip: \"Copy signature — pasteable into API or CLI (includes param names)\"
Sam (A11y): alternate microcopy for aria: \"Copy function signature for calculateOrder. Includes parameter names.\"
Tara (Design): prefer shorter tooltip: \"Copy function signature (for API/CLI)\"
Marta (DevEx): ok locking on Tara's tooltip + Sam's aria pattern. thanks all :thumbsup:
Kai (Eng): quick question — should copy place text on clipboard as plain text or code fenced? i prefer plain text to make CLI paste simpler.
Tara (Design): plain text. UI can show a tiny ephemeral code preview if user long-presses.
Marta (DevEx): got it. i'll update the spec and add the aria examples. finishing notes: keep the chip visible when collapsed, use tooltip for verbose signature, debounce updates, telemetry for events, live-region announce on handoff.
Ravi (PM): awesome. closing loop — will add to the sprint board.
Tara (Design): uploading 2 mock images now.
Marta (DevEx): received. thanks everyone.
